source_name: PEZA List of Economic Zones (as of 30 June 2024)
variables_used: zone name, location, developer, area (sqm), region, zone type, operating status
credibility: official Philippine government agency administering all economic zones
limitation: no coordinates; addresses are text strings requiring geocoding; no explicit establishment year
next_step: geocode addresses via RCC-GIS; extract proclamation dates from PEZA website per zone

variables_used: latitude, longitude, match score per zone address
credibility: University of Chicago institutional Esri geocoder
limitation: 14 zones returned 0 match score (dropped); some rural addresses may be imprecise
next_step: spot-check low-scoring geocodes against Google Maps; manually correct outliers

variables_used: admin3 (municipality) names and pcodes, admin2 (province) names and pcodes
credibility: OCHA Common Operational Dataset sourced from PSA and NAMRIA
limitation: used gazetteer for name-matching rather than spatial join; some municipality names differ from PEZA conventions
next_step: use shapefile for point-in-polygon join if shapefile reads successfully

variables_used: total population by sex and age group, province level, 2022-2025 projections
credibility: UNFPA-validated projections based on PSA 2015 Census
limitation: projections not actuals; province-level aggregation masks within-province variation
next_step: link to 2020 Census actuals at municipality level for finer resolution

variables_used: population exposed to flooding at return periods 10/50/100/500yr by demographic group
credibility: HeiGIT / Heidelberg Institute for Geoinformation Technology; established flood modelling
limitation: exposure estimates depend on flood model assumptions; 30cm depth threshold
next_step: cross-reference with PAGASA historical flood data

variables_used: counts of hospitals, primary healthcare facilities, education facilities per province
credibility: HeiGIT; facility locations likely sourced from OpenStreetMap
limitation: OSM coverage varies; rural facilities may be underrepresented
next_step: validate against DOH National Health Facility Registry

variables_used: rural population counts by demographic group, rural population share per province
credibility: HeiGIT; based on population distribution models
limitation: rural/urban classification depends on model resolution

variables_used: population within 5/10/20km of education, within 30min/1h/2h of hospitals and primary healthcare
credibility: HeiGIT; travel time estimates based on road network analysis
limitation: travel time models assume normal conditions; actual access affected by traffic and geography
next_step: validate with ground-truth travel surveys if available

source_name: BIR Monthly Internal Revenue Collections by Province (2016-2024)
variables_used: monthly tax revenue by region and province, CY 2016-2024
credibility: Bureau of Internal Revenue via Open Data Philippines; official government tax data
limitation: province-level aggregation; does not separate zone-specific tax from general provincial revenue
next_step: use as outcome variable in staggered DiD linking zone establishment to provincial tax revenue

source_name: Wikipedia: List of Special Economic Zones in the Philippines
variables_used: zone names, locations, developers, region, area
credibility: community-maintained but well-sourced from PEZA and government proclamations
limitation: may be outdated or incomplete relative to official PEZA list
